description: Specify the locations of the sides of the domain. Each set of values applies to the lower and upper bound of that dimension of the domain. If only fxl and fxu are specified, then the domain is a cube.

notes: Live 6.00: both 'model domain extent' and the legacy bare 'domain extent' parse (the bare top-level 'domain' command is not shown in the top-level keyword enum - a hidden alias). The bare-domain enum additionally lists per-component strain-rate-xx..zz and tolerance.
Live-verified on PFC3D 7.00: the command is 'model domain extent' (a bare 'domain ...' top-level command does not exist).
